<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333;"><span style="font-size: 10em;"><b>&nbsp;</b></span></span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: center; text-decoration: none;"><span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333;"><span style="font-size: 9em;"><b>Chen Ping</b></span></span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: center; text-decoration: none;"><span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333;"><span style="font-size: 10em;"><b>&nbsp;</b></span></span></p><p style="text-align: center;">

<img style="filter: invert(1); border: 0; outline: none;" alt="" height="529" src="data:image/png;base64," width="267" /></p><p><style type="text/css">p { margin-bottom: 0.1in; direction: ltr; color: #000000; line-height: 120%; orphans: 2; widows: 2; background: transparent }p.western { font-family: "Liberation Serif", "Times New Roman", serif; font-size: 12pt; so-language: en-US }p.cjk { font-family: "Noto Sans CJK SC Regular"; font-size: 12pt; so-language: zh-CN }p.ctl { font-family: "FreeSans"; font-size: 12pt; so-language: hi-IN }a:link { color: #000080; so-language: zxx; text-decoration: underline }</style></p><p>&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>
	

</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">Chen
Ping (</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">陈平</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">,
d. 178 B.C.) was a politician and military strategist who served as a
chancellor in early Western Han Dynasty. As an advisor, he played an
important role in helping Liu Bang, the founding emperor of Han
Dynasty, to overcome his rival, Xiang Yu, during the Chu–Han
Contention. </span>
</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">There
are six main strategies for which Chen Ping is best known. One of
these -- namely, Chen Ping’s Sixth Strategy -- we have already
mentioned (cf. Stratagem 31). The preceding five strategies of Chen
Ping we discuss in these remaining chapters.</span></p>

<p><style type="text/css">p { margin-bottom: 0.1in; direction: ltr; color: #000000; line-height: 120%; orphans: 2; widows: 2; background: transparent }p.western { font-family: "Liberation Serif", "Times New Roman", serif; font-size: 12pt; so-language: en-US }p.cjk { font-family: "Noto Sans CJK SC Regular"; font-size: 12pt; so-language: zh-CN }p.ctl { font-family: "FreeSans"; font-size: 12pt; so-language: hi-IN }a:link { color: #000080; so-language: zxx; text-decoration: underline }</style></p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;</p>


&nbsp;<p><b style="color: #333333; font-size: 9em;"></b></p><p><b style="color: #333333; font-size: 9em;">37</b> </p><p></p><p>

</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="font-size: 2em;"><b><span style="color: #333333;">Chen Ping’s First
Strategy</span></b></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<br />

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><i>Sowing Discord Between Xiang Yu and His Advisor Fan Zeng</i></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">During
the latter part of the Chu-Han contention, on the southern front, Liu
Bang's forces had begun forging supply routes from Xingyang to
Aocang. In 204 B.C., after suffering losses from Chu attacks on these
routes, the Han army ran short of supplies. Liu Bang subsequently
negotiated for peace with Xiang Yu, and offered to cede to him all of
the lands east of Xingyang. Fan Zeng </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">(</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">范增</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">,
<span style="text-decoration: none;">277-204
B.C.) </span><span style="text-decoration: none;">advised
Xiang Yu to reject this offer, and to use the opportunity to destroy
Liu Bang. Xiang Yu heeded Fan Zeng, pressed an attack on Xingyang and
besieged Liu Bang's forces inside the city. Liu Bang then took Chen
Ping's suggestion and bribed Xiang Yu's men with 40,000 catties of
gold, having them spread </span><u>rumors</u><span style="text-decoration: none;">
that Fan Zeng intended </span><u>to
betray</u><span style="text-decoration: none;">
Xiang Yu. Falling for the ruse, Xiang Yu dismissed Fan Zeng, who then
died of an illness on his journey home. The loss of Fan Zeng was one
of the factors that contributed to Xiang Yu's eventual defeat </span><span style="text-decoration: none;">[18],
[20]</span><span style="text-decoration: none;">.</span></span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">Sowing
Discord Between Xiang Yu and His Advisor Fan Zeng</span></i></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><span style="font-style: normal;">
is an application of the seventh stratagem,</span><i>
Create Something out of Nothing</i><span style="font-style: normal;">,
which is associated with</span>
the second hexagram, <i>Earth
over Earth</i>, and the
24th hexagram, <i>Earth
over Thunder</i><i><span style="text-decoration: none;">
</span></i><span style="font-style: normal;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">[1],
[28]</span></span>.</span></p>

<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><b>Sample Sentences 37:</b></span></p>

<div dir="ltr" id="Section89" style="column-count: 2;"><div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他每个星期的一三五，举重一个小时，然</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;后蛙泳三十分钟。</span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	2) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">站在球上，她不能保持平衡。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: Standing on the ball,
	she can’t keep her balance.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	3) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">不应该和陌生人说话。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: One should not talk
	to strangers.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">
    4) </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important; font-size: large">有传闻说他背叛了自己的国家。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	5) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">那艘船漂浮在海上。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
    6) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你为什么<span style="text-decoration: none;"><span lang="zh-CN">扔掉</span></span>电磁炉？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;A: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">弄坏了。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
    7) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">对不起，这里没有澡盆。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
    8) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">有危险的自由比和平的<span style="text-decoration: none;"><span lang="zh-CN">奴隶制更好。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	9)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">新西兰没有狼。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	10) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">好多中国人喜欢用电水壶泡茶。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	11) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">哪个国家有最好的人权？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">
    12) </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important; font-size: large">请不要相信那些关于我的谣言。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	13) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">囚犯的权力很少。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	14) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">一些材料没有液体的形态，只有固体和</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;气体的形态。</span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	15) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我意外地删除了你的手机号，再给我一</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;次可以吗？</span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	16) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我们需不需要交税？</span></span></span></p>
</div>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><br />

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333;">-------------------------------------</span></p>
